verdict.rationale:
Dagster+ ships an official MCP server described as letting AI sessions 'access information and take actions in your Dagster+ deployment,' which is the concrete mechanism for natural-language operation, and Dagster also maintains an AI skill giving coding agents context for building Dagster projects. However, evidence is limited to brief doc mentions with no hands-on demonstration of natural-language commands actually driving runs/materializations, and the MCP capability is scoped to Dagster+ (not core OSS Dagster).

missing for 10: hands-on/independent evidence of NL commands successfully operating Dagster (not just docs claim), coverage for OSS (non-Dagster+) users, richer detail on the range of actions supported via MCP.
